summary: Your will can be formidable. Conflict may expose where power, fear, and desire are already charged.
body: Mars opposition Pluto describes intense drive, strong survival instincts, and a complicated relationship with force. You may sense power dynamics quickly and resist being dominated, sometimes before anyone has made a move. This can give enormous stamina, courage, and capacity for transformation, but it can also turn conflict into a battle for control. The gift is focused power. The growth is learning when to apply force, when to stand down, and when the real fight is with an old pattern.
gift: Stamina, courage, strategic force, and the ability to confront difficult realities directly.
shadow: Power struggles, coercion, suppressed anger, and treating every challenge as a contest of wills.
integration: Use intensity with consent and purpose. Power becomes cleaner when it is not trying to prove that no one can control you.
do: Ask what power dynamic is being activated
dont: Fight just to avoid feeling vulnerable
